en traktat.explanation: "En traktat" means "a treaty". To say countries sign one, use the verb "at underskrive" (to sign): "at underskrive en traktat" (to sign a treaty).

en traktor.explanation: "En traktor" means "a tractor". A person who drives one is "en traktorfører" (a tractor driver), built from "traktor" and "en fører" (a driver).

en trang.explanation: "En trang" means "an urge". To say what you feel an urge for, add "til" (for): "en trang til sødt" (a craving for sweets). When you describe a narrow room, the describing word "trang" means "narrow": "et trangt rum" (a narrow room).

en transaktion.explanation: "En transaktion" means "a transaction". To say you carry one out, use the verb "at foretage" (to carry out): "at foretage en transaktion" (to carry out a transaction).

en trappe.explanation: "En trappe" means "a staircase / stairs". When you walk down the stairs, say "ned ad trappen" (down the stairs): "Jeg går ned ad trappen" (I walk down the stairs).

en tredjedel.explanation: "En tredjedel" means "a third". It is built from "tredje" (third) and "en del" (a part). To say two thirds, use the plural: "to tredjedele" (two thirds).

en trekant.explanation: "En trekant" means "a triangle". It is built from "tre" (three) and "en kant" (an edge). For the musical instrument, use "en triangel" (the percussion triangle): "Hun spiller triangel" (She plays the triangle).

en tremmeseng.explanation: "En tremmeseng" means "a crib". It is built from "en tremme" (a bar) and "en seng" (a bed).

en trillebør.explanation: "En trillebør" means "a wheelbarrow". The first part comes from the verb "at trille" (to roll). To say you push a wheelbarrow, use "at skubbe" (to push): "Han skubber trillebøren hen til haven" (He pushes the wheelbarrow to the garden).

en troldmand.explanation: "En troldmand" means "a wizard". It is built from "en trold" (a troll) and "en mand" (a man).

en tromme.explanation: "En tromme" means "a drum". A person who plays the drums is "en trommeslager" (a drummer).

en trompet.explanation: "En trompet" means "a trumpet". A person who plays the trumpet is "en trompetist" (a trumpeter).

en trone.explanation: "En trone" means "a throne". When a prince will become king after his father, say "at arve tronen" (to inherit the throne).

en trop.explanation: "En trop" means "a troop". To say a country sends soldiers abroad, use the plural: "Landet sender tropper til udlandet" (The country sends troops abroad).

en trussel.explanation: "En trussel" means "a threat". It is the noun for the verb "at true" (to threaten). To say a threat to something, add "mod" (against): "en trussel mod miljøet" (a threat to the environment).

en trækfugl.explanation: "En trækfugl" means "a migratory bird". To say a bird stays in Denmark all year, use its opposite, "en standfugl" (a resident bird): "Gråspurven er en standfugl" (The house sparrow is a resident bird).

en træner.explanation: "En træner" means "a coach". It comes from the verb "at træne" (to train). To say whose coach someone is, add "for" (for): "Hun er træner for pigeholdet" (She is the coach of the girls' team).

en trøje.explanation: "En trøje" means "a sweater". To name a sports shirt, put the sport in front: "en fodboldtrøje" (a soccer jersey).

en tudse.explanation: "En tudse" means "a toad". Do not mix it up with "en frø" (a frog): "Der sidder en frø i søen" (A frog is sitting in the lake).

en tunge.explanation: "En tunge" means "a tongue". To say you stick out your tongue at someone, say "at række tunge ad nogen" (to stick out your tongue at someone).

en tunnel.explanation: "En tunnel" means "a tunnel". In Aalborg, "Limfjordstunnelen" (the Limfjord tunnel) takes the motorway under the water.

en tur.explanation: "En tur" means "a trip, turn". When you leave home for an outing, say "at tage på tur" (to go on a trip): "Vi tager på tur i weekenden" (We are going on a trip this weekend). When it is your move in a game, say "Det er din tur" (It is your turn).

en turist.explanation: "En turist" means "a tourist". A person who lives in a place is "en indbygger" (a resident): "Der bor mange indbyggere i byen" (Many residents live in the city).

en turistattraktion.explanation: "En turistattraktion" means "a tourist attraction". It is built from "en turist" (a tourist) and "en attraktion" (an attraction).
